
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
set.seed(42)
```

```{r}
numbers<-c(1,2,3,4,5)
breakfast <- c("eggs", "bacon", "sausages", "toast","black pudding","hash brown", "waffles", "pancakes", "beans")
break_df<-tibble()
for (i in seq_len(10)) {
  item <- sample(breakfast, size = 1)
  num <- sample(numbers, size = 1)
  row <- tibble(
    item = item,
    count = num
  )
  break_df <- bind_rows(break_df, row)
}
gt(break_df)
```
